dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet" or DeviceProduct startswith "Fortigate"
| extend tmpMsg = tostring(columnifexists("Message",""))
| extend tmpAct = tostring(columnifexists("Activity",""))
| extend tmpCombined = iff(isnotempty(tmpMsg), tmpMsg, tmpAct)
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward close"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward client-rst"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward server-rst"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward timeout"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward cancel"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward client-fin"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:forward server-fin"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:local close"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:local client-rst"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:local timeout"
| where tmpCombined !has "traffic:local server-rst"
| project-away tmpMsg, tmpAct, tmpCombined
